judgments.rationale: The proposed edit remedies defects in C0001 by supplying the missing action and object directly from the statutory text of clause (i) (F005) and incorporating the governing qualification conditions of referenced clause (ii) (F007:F009), which restricts the election to single-employer plans in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007 that had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) as of the end of that year.

source_spans.quote: In the case of a single-employer plan described in clause (ii), the plan sponsor may elect to maintain a funding standard carryover balance, until such balance is reduced to zero.

(ii) Plans maintaining funding standard account in 2007 A plan is described in this clause if the plan—

(I) was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007, and

(II) had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) of this title as in effect for such plan year and determined as of the end of such plan year.
